name: plugin-tereno
description: Pre-signature security layer for ElizaOS agents on Base: buy a bounded verdict (unlimited-approval, drainer, suspicious-contract, balance/gas anomaly) before signing. Budget-capped, fail-closed, standardized verdict, dry-run.

TERENO_PRIVATE_KEY.description: EVM private key of the wallet that pays x402 calls (needs USDC on Base). Falls back to EVM_PRIVATE_KEY.

TERENO_PRIVATE_ONLY.description: Set to true to refuse paid actions from public Discord/Telegram/Twitter sources.

TERENO_NETWORK.description: eip155:8453 (Base mainnet, default) or eip155:84532 (Base Sepolia).

TERENO_FAIL_MODE.description: closed (default) makes financial checks abort when the guard cannot answer; open degrades to review. Never auto-signs on failure.

TERENO_DRY_RUN.description: Set to true to simulate checks with no x402 payment (works with no wallet).

TERENO_TELEMETRY.description: Set to off to disable anonymous, allowlisted usage telemetry (hashed wallet only; never keys/prompts).
